title: cmd_update_patterns' rewritten insertion path (with_state_lock, write_atomic, _splice_pattern_file, both missing-heading skips) still has zero runtime coverage -- the only test seeds a duplicate so new_findings stays 0, and it still resolves pattern_file from committed plugin source

the widened T42 AC4 regex requires a literal backslash on both sides so it matches only skills/srd/SKILL.md:182's escaped form -- the test reports exactly one quoting form while twenty unescaped references exist in the tree; B1 and B2 are fixed, B4's self-consistency identity is not
every grep -c in an assignment across wave6 and wave7 now carries a guard or routes through the new count_matches helper, so a zero-match count fails one assertion instead of aborting the suite

dimensions 3 and 4 now execute against the synthetic fixture but no dimension carries an expected-value assertion -- the vague-AC detector still never matches, dimension 3 never sees an invalid diagram, and dimension 4 never sees a fabricated ID, so an inverted dimension still scores 100 for every input

convergence_exempt still has zero occurrences anywhere in bin/tests -- neither consumer, neither mode half, and not the deliberate asymmetry that approve-gate code-audit stays refused under fast-track

the pricing tests now assert each frozen previous-generation rate against an exact literal and that an env override does not change it for opus, sonnet and haiku, and pin the documented in-family mispricing warning plus its Sonnet placeholder cost
the git-history assertion is deleted and the T34 block now asserts tree state only; no git log assertion remains anywhere in bin/tests
the shared-lint invariant is now enforced by two real assertions re-checking cwd, EDM_SRD_ROOT and a git status --porcelain fingerprint against the values captured before the T48 block

the tiering matrix now has an exactly-80-percent QUALIFY and a 79-percent DISQUALIFIED boundary case, a deliberate matching-count-different-IDs case, a real-path invocation case, and run_matrix dies rather than exiting 0 on empty output

residual after the CRASH, zero-assertion and no-summary branches landed: there is still no minimum-suite-count floor, so deleting or renaming wave7-smoke.sh drops 830 assertions and the aggregate reports ALL SUITES PASSED

residual after the --force, ^agent: and T58 AC1 controls landed: roughly twenty zero-count assertions still carry none, including the duplicate --force check in wave6, the three T66 AC4 deleted-text counts, both code_audit_converged checks, and a mapfile regex that still cannot match mapfile<file

only the clean direction of the fence-indentation fix is tested -- v12-indented-fence.md proves an indented plain fence suppresses, but no fixture proves an indented mermaid fence is still scanned, so reverting the half CHANGELOG.md:46 names as missed violations keeps the suite green

residual after the missing-baseline guard landed and was tested: the command's exit code and output are still discarded via >/dev/null 2>&1 || true, no check_refuses_and_leaves_state helper was added, and the four read-only sites still have no output assertion

the nine CLAUDE.md in-layout assertions are unchanged and still match a bare filename anywhere in a thousand-line file, so moving an artifact out of the layout block while mentioning it once in prose keeps all nine green

the four-job lint-split loop scores a nonexistent job as compliant because an absent job yields an empty awk block containing no allow_failure, existence and stage and checker-union are still unasserted, and wave7:3402 still prints the split as an unfixed gap while :1015 and :3383 treat it as landed

residual after the alternation count was split into four scoped assertions: sed -n '69,106p' still pins three assertions to absolute line numbers in a file other tickets edit freely, while _wave7_extract_section written to replace exactly this is used at one site in the whole suite

the T67 AC11 network-call scan over nine blocking CI jobs has the same delete-a-job blind spot -- an absent job yields an empty body that matches no network pattern and is scored clean, so removing test:smoke from the pipeline keeps the assertion green

the two new shared helpers count_matches and assert_absent_with_control have no self-test in harness-smoke.sh despite being the remediation vehicles for CA-036 and CA-037 at 21 call sites, and count_matches collapses grep's file-not-found exit 2 into 0, which is the passing value for every expect-zero caller

the aggregator's own result accounting -- rewritten by CA-016's remediation with three new branches -- is covered by no test at all; run-all.sh is not a *-smoke.sh so it never self-discovers, harness-smoke.sh has no case for it, and wave7:339 only greps its text

timing.sh's seven measurement modes are covered by a single grep for the token generate-fixture plus an executable-bit check, so a stub echoing that one word passes both; the script produces the committed latency budgets in CHANGELOG.md and CLAUDE.md and is exercised nowhere else

the L4-visible half is fixed -- wave7 now carries trap rm -rf TMP on EXIT INT TERM and T43_SCRATCH is created under TMP so the 200-line block is trap-covered -- the remaining wave6 trees and fake-HOME concerns belong to L5, L7 and L8

not re-verified this round -- the 1..10 character walk is present in both strip_entities implementations but the T43 scratch fixtures were not read closely enough to confirm whether the two prescribed boundary lines were added
